title: Block
description: A single block in a SCHEDULE day's AM or PM. Either a phase marker (groupLabel only) or a real block.

groupLabel.description: Header text for the phase marker (e.g. 'PHASE 1 · RECONNAISSANCE')

label.description: Visible name in the schedule grid

sub.description: Optional italic sublabel under the title

code.description: Optional — links to ACTIVITIES entry by code

tracks.description: Optional alternative to 'track' for blocks spanning multiple specialty tracks (e.g. Business+Market joint sessions). When set, the renderer applies all listed track styles and the track filter shows the block for any matching view.

audiences.description: Who's in the room. Default audiences when omitted: [student, alumni].

facilitator_roles.description: Which facilitator slots own the block. Default when omitted: [f1].

oneOf.description: AI-methodology loop metadata. Populate only on blocks where the AI loop applies.

structure.description: How AI structures the analog input

reality_check.description: How the loop output is tested

kind.description: Visual category — controls color in the schedule grid

slide.description: Block detail content rendered in slide-mode drill-down

students.description: Bullet list of what students actually do

facilitator.description: Notes for the person running it

notes.description: Append-only meta notes about this block. Author + ISO timestamp + text. Optional, default empty array.

ts.description: ISO 8601 datetime. Updated to edit time when a note is edited.

edited.description: Optional. Set to true when a note has been edited at least once. Renders as '(edited)' inline.

status.description: ready = Owen-reviewed; draft = exists, needs review; stub = placeholder
